thread:
oliver.t: Hey team - prepping for parental leave starting Oct 10. Couple edge things: planning a short trip to Canada during week 2 for documentation - does that change anything for benefits/tax? Also thinking of taking 6 weeks paid + 6 weeks unpaid, want to preserve PTO for later. Finally, can we get a recruiter contractor for 10 weeks to cover hiring ops?
people-ops: Congrats Oliver! :tada: Short answers: 1) International travel under 30 days usually doesn't change benefit eligibility but can affect payroll tax withholding and healthcare provider access. Please CC benefits@redwood.com with travel dates so Payroll can advise. 2) You can stack paid weeks then switch to unpaid; PTO can be reserved if you select "defer PTO" on the leave form. 3) Contractor for hiring coverage is ok; submit a hiring intake and mark it "parental leave coverage" for expedited review.
payroll-bot: Heads up: to guarantee Redwood top-up aligns with SDI payments, upload your EDD/SDI docs to https://benefits.redwood.com/leave-forms and tag them "EDD determination" before the payroll cutoff which is the last day of the pay period containing your first paid leave day. If you go unpaid after paid weeks, PTO accrual pauses during unpaid time.
oliver.t: Thanks. If I file for CFRA/SDI now and get the EDD determination after the leave starts, can top-up be retroactive?
people-ops: Top-up can be retroactive to your first paid leave day as long as EDD docs are uploaded within 30 days of the determination notice. Payroll processes retro pay next cycle after docs are in. If you expect delays, flag "expedite" in the upload comment.
frank.mgr: Oliver, I can take recruiting oversight and triage urgent interviews. For the recruiter contractor, please list priority roles and weekly time commitment so Hiring Ops can scope.
hiring-ops: Fast-track tip: put estimated bill rate and scope in the intake form. We can usually approve 10-week contract in 5 business days if budget is available and manager sign-off is on the form. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/hiring-intake -> Temporary Contractor.
oliver.t: Great  Ill set the intake to 10 weeks and tag Frank. One more Q: is the childcare subsidy pro-rated if I return part-time?
benefits-bot: Childcare stipend policy: stipend accrues while on active payroll as an eligible employee. If you switch to part-time and remain benefits-eligible, stipend continues but may be prorated based on FTE if >60 days at reduced FTE. Confirm specifics with benefits@redwood.com.
payroll-bot: Note: If you travel to Canada and receive local travel reimbursements, check with benefits for potential taxable implications. Submit receipts to expenses.redwood.com and tag "Parental travel".
oliver.t: Thanks all. Last ops ask: Ill keep lightweight PagerDuty on-call for the first 2 weeks; any preferred handoff pattern?
frank.mgr: Let's do primary coverage by me and secondary by Priya, with your on-call set to auto-escalate to me after 10 minutes. Oliver, share a 1-page runbook and the few sticky playbooks and well run a 30-min handoff tomorrow.
oplepeople-ops: If you want to protect fully, we can temporarily remove your primary escalation duty; otherwise a read-only on-call window is fine. Book a leave check-in with me if you want us to handle the escalation config.
oliver.t: Will upload SDI when I file and send the runbook. Appreciate the quick answers :heart:
